'''Lucky Lunch''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

'''Note:''' This recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients.

Lucky Lunch may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], at the [[Traveling Cart]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, 
or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. It is also sold by the [[Desert Festival#Calico Egg Merchant|Calico Egg Merchant]] in the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|10|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s.

One or two Lucky Lunches may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. Two Lucky Lunches may be received from opening a [[Golden Mystery Box]]. One Lucky Lunch is the reward for completing the {{Bundle|treasure hunter's|24|y}}.

==Recipes==

==Tailoring==
Lucky Lunch is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt052.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

Lucky Lunch is not used in any [[Quests|quests]].
